description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'GenericXaResource', which extends Thread and implements the XAResource interface. It provides a generic implementation for a transactional XA resource, supporting enlistment, preparation, recovery, timeout handling, and resource management within a JTA transaction environment.

classes.name: GenericXaResource
classes.description: An abstract class that provides common functionality for XA resources, such as enlistment, timeout handling, and state management, intended for use in transactional environments.

methods.name: enlist
methods.description: Enlists the resource in the current transaction obtained from the TransactionManager.

methods.name: enlist
methods.description: Enlists the resource in the specified transaction.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins work on the transaction branch identified by the Xid, starting a dedicated thread for timeout handling.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends work on the transaction branch, updating active state.

methods.name: forget
methods.description: Removes the reference to the Xid if it matches the current one.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the resource for transaction commit.

methods.name: recover
methods.description: Recovers Xids in the transaction log.

methods.name: isSameRM
methods.description: Checks if the given XAResource is the same resource manager as this.

methods.name: getTransaction
methods.description: Returns the transaction associated with this resource.

methods.name: setTransaction
methods.description: Associates a transaction with this resource.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active state of the resource.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the resource is active.

methods.name: setXid
methods.description: Assigns an Xid to this resource.

methods.name: getXid
methods.description: Returns the Xid associated with this resource.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Abstract method to commit the transaction branch.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Abstract method to rollback the transaction branch.

methods.name: runOnTimeout
methods.description: Hook method invoked when the transaction times out.
